Ivide thannulla sevaakal (main): 

- Shodhanaum Shamanavum (ama-vata/ rheumatoid arthritisinu vendi)  
- Nidana parivarjana (karanam niravarthikkuga/avoidance of causes)  
- Internal medications (herbal formulations, dosha vitiation anusarichu)  
- Ahara parivarthanam (dietary changes)  
- Yoga, vyayam (exercise) mathrum dhyanam (meditation)  
- Rasayana therapy  
- Therapeutic treatments: snehana, swedhana, shirodhara, vasya, pichu, lepanam, etc.  

Post-maternity care package includes:  
- Abhyanga (medicated oil body massage)  
- Kizhi  
- Lepanam (herbal paste)  
- Herbal bath  
- Dhoopanam  
- Anjanam  
- Bandaging the belly

(Sevakal dosha prakaram tailor cheythu kodukkappedum.)
